parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Wallpaper/Tests/WallpaperTests/QualityMetricsAggregatorTests.swift`. Despite a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.8636), the two methods — `tracksInterpolationEnabledPercent` (line 266) and `countsInterpolationActivations` (line 374) — are distinct test cases exercising different observable behaviours of `QualityMetricsAggregator` (percent tracking vs. activation counting). Near-duplicate test bodies are a well-known pattern where shared setup logic is intentional and the differing assertions are the load-bearing content; collapsing them would obscure test intent and couple unrelated failure modes.
